searchServices.name: Firecrawl MCP
searchServices.description: Authenticated web search with best results via Firecrawl MCP. Part of the project's MCP configuration with sources: ["web", "alexandria"]. Provides structured data and web search capabilities.

searchServices.name: Context7 MCP
searchServices.description: Library and documentation search via Context7 MCP. Fetches current documentation for frameworks, SDKs, APIs, and CLI tools. Preferred over web search for library-specific queries.

searchServices.name: free-search MCP
searchServices.description: Keyless multi-engine web search via free-search MCP. No API key needed; aggregates results from Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Wikipedia, and other engines. Falls back when authenticated services are unavailable.

searchServices.name: Exa MCP (conditional)
searchServices.description: High-quality search via Exa MCP. Available when API key is configured. Provides superior relevance for certain query types but not currently configured with API key.

unifiedSearch.description: Unified search service that tries Firecrawl first (authenticated, best results), falls back to free-search (no key needed), and uses Context7 for library/docs queries. Results are cached per query with 5-minute TTL.

testQueryResults.firecrawl: Would return authenticated web search results for multi-tenant SaaS architecture
testQueryResults.freeSearch: Would return keyless multi-engine search results
testQueryResults.context7: Would return library docs for Next.js, Supabase, Prisma, etc.
